resumeText: Charlotte Dubois is a GenAI Application Developer at Lumen Assist with four years of experience. She builds full-stack AI features end to end: Python services in FastAPI calling OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, RAG flows backed by vector stores, and React frontends that stream responses to users. She packages everything with Docker and works daily with PostgreSQL and Redis. Previously at Citrus Digital she built Python and React web services. She bridges product needs and ML pipelines effectively.
